scope: Authorisation and conditions of the provisional pilot execution; not an outcome record
protocol_clause: protocols/PROTOCOL.md: pilot cases are frozen only after the author has verified G1-G5 against the retained bytes
description: The seven provisional pilot papers rest on Devin's delegated first-pass G1-G5 assessment (DEV-2026-09-23-01). The author has not yet verified or overturned those gates. The pilot was nevertheless executed so that harness behaviour and stopping points could be observed before the main sample.

authorisation.verbatim_selection: Devin一次判定のまま暫定パイロットをdeviation記録付きで実行する（API費用・長時間実行あり）

consequences: Pilot runs are excluded from the main sample and from any success rate.
Pilot selection is not author-adjudicated and must not be presented as such.
If author verification overturns a gate that affects eligibility, the affected stratum is re-selected before any counted run.
Claimed reports are sealed unadjudicated; L1-L5 remain not_adjudicated until blind adjudication and human validation.

served_material.per_slot: one identity-verified open PMC JATS article plus the pinned free dependency closure
served_material.reason: No deposited study input was simultaneously public, below the 64 MiB retention cap, machine-readable and free of outcome leakage; see the retained acquisition ledger under data/raw/pilot-inputs-20260924/
served_material.outcome_leakage_exclusion: The Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.6377228 files retained for PMID:36493775 are the figure source tables of the target itself. They are kept as raw evidence for post-reveal validation and were not served to any solver.

execution_conditions.independence: separate broker journal, separate served package, fresh isolated worker, no shared mutable state, no parent or sibling debugging
execution_conditions.freeze_order: target and allowed manifests hashed and RFC3161 timestamped before the first solver call; blind outcomes sealed and timestamped before any reveal-class request

harness_iterations.observation: 20 of 21 slots stopped on harness limits rather than on study evidence: context-budget exhaustion from full tool output, worker termination on a single oversized print, provider completion truncation and one malformed action.
harness_iterations.disposition: retained, not discarded; not usable as evidence about the papers

changes: tool output is recorded in full and truncated only in the model context
an oversized print no longer terminates the run or the worker; only the wall limit does
a truncated or malformed action is recorded and returned to the solver within a fixed budget instead of ending the run
larger wall, token, completion and tool-call envelope

unqualified_at_execution_time: provider-hosted model-side retrieval, web, Git, MCP and session tool restriction
prior model-training exposure, which cannot be certified absent at runtime
